comparison.objective: Feed a press blank to a backstop while holding a gravity guard no more than 8 cm open; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand controls guard aperture while the other pushes a blank with a stick, then lowers the guard versus one hand stabilizes a coaxial mandrel while the other hammers, followed by fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Blank seated, stick removed, guard never over-raised and safely lowered versus four fractures, four contained tangs, intact inserts/shell, and stable tool release.
comparison.reason: Both require asymmetric bimanual coordination, but guarded feeding and aperture control differ materially from precision impact fracture and cleanup.
